structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions
Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University
Virginia Center for Coal and Energy Research

law.text:
The board shall appoint an executive director for the Center who, subject to the approval of the board, shall:
Exercise all powers and perform all duties imposed upon him by law;
Carry out the specific duties imposed upon him by the board; and
Employ such personnel and contract for such services as may be required to carry out the purposes of this article.
